$comment: Part I Section C — XML mapping for the procurement procedure and project. Note the three different UBL homes: the procedure fields are DOCUMENT-HEADER elements (cbc:ProcedureCode, cbc:ContractFolderID), the project is a cac:ProcurementProject aggregate, and the lots are repeated cac:ProcurementProjectLot wrappers. Attribute sets are Schematron-mandated: BR-OTH-01 (3 code attributes on ProcedureCode), BR-OTH-02 (@schemeAgencyID on ContractFolderID and on each lot cbc:ID).

rules.$comment: BR-OTH-02 (fatal) — the buyer's file reference. @schemeAgencyID names the agency owning the reference numbering scheme; the file reference carries no scheme field to derive it from (it is the buyer's own internal reference), so it resolves to the DEFAULT of the 'identifier-scheme-agency' profile (model-sources/registries/scheme-agency-profile.json → 'OP'). Not user-entered; no `path` means the default applies.
BR-SC-10 (fatal) — the procedure type MUST be present. BR-OTH-01 (fatal) requires listID/listAgencyID/listVersionID, supplied by expanding the procurement-procedure-type shorthand.

One repeated cac:ProcurementProjectLot per lot id. The lot cbc:ID carries the criterion identifier scheme ('criterion' shorthand -> schemeID/schemeAgencyID/schemeVersionID), matching ESPD-Request-BASE.xml. Selection criteria reference these ids (BR-LOT-41).
